PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
No. 1991/21 – TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 01, 2016
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
Ref. No.: MCUDP/LA/MUT (W-14)/14/02/S.

I, hereby give notice under sub-section (1) of section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire and own the servitude rights of the following blocks of land for the construction of a tunnel drainage line from the main canal in Aluth Mawatha area up to the sea which is a sub-project under taken Metro Colombo Urban Development Project.

Description of the Land: The undermentioned allotments of land situated in Aluth Mawatha Village belonging to Aluth Mawatha Grama Niladhari Division in the Colombo Divisional Secretary’s Division in the District of Colombo Western Province made by the Surveyor General on 07.10.2016 and depicted as Lots No. 01-61, 64, 66-68 in the Preliminary Plan No. ෙකʣ 9654 containing in extent 0.4478 Hectare.
